conclusion: No unresolved material dossier-quality issue found within this bounded independent review. The historical candidate remains blocked for native App adoption. This is neither expert acceptance, policy repair nor promotion.
scope: Complete independent native replay and exact identity/coverage checks of one raw run. All9 new measure-original pages, all42 new NAPV pages including every annex/list/footnote, all8 native production modules and all21 numbered assumptions plus input-default notes were read directly. Selected shared clauses and original tables were independently crosschecked. This is not a second full semantic adjudication of every common-source page, all ten data files or every catalog assessment.
excluded_materials: No public study-reference cases, private references, GM/expert labels, model-self-test expected answers or manual-adaptation test labels are source oracles. Fresh public source components, desired positive-evidence contracts, identity diagnostics and schema stress retain separate scopes.

source_reading.shared_reading: Eight shared full-source readings are reused only by exact matching source hashes. GSP-AV is actually in this historical packet: its d01dd802 hash matches the previously documented full94page reading at o6_1c/o6_4. Current GSP pages10/11/23/24/30/31/86, SRL11/23/61/62/63, ATB5/6/7/9/14/18/19 and AnnexA3 were directly reread. Shared-source reuse does not retroactively credit GSP to earlier runs lacking it.
source_reading.original_image_check: Original MB page5 rendered image directly inspected. The157g average cell visibly spans all3 fattening phases; accompanying average-OR-phase sentence confirmed. A02 is misleading only in its placement description. No executable defect is inferred from that description.
source_reading.reading_hygiene: A multi-page source output was truncated at GSP23/24 and those pages were explicitly reread in a separate untruncated extraction. An unrelated AnnexB page was incidentally extracted while locating AnnexA; no next-measure finding uses it. Quote search and page bounds are not substituted for full reading.

replay.comparison: Complete regenerated observations byte-match the final newly bound stored observations; no --write or historical mutation.
replay.interpretation: Successful reproduction retains matching and nonmatching expectations. Selected public development probes are not model accuracy, held-out expert gold or proof of totality.

native_loading.representation: Actual namespace, directories, original numeric JSON representations and exact frozen binary are retained without flattening, canonical rewriting or numeric normalization.

coverage_quality.table_scope: All29 inventoried pointers in10 data files and all232 direct stored entries were independently compared to their exact historical values.41 additional metadata leaves are separately reviewed in the primary table part. Independent original semantic control below covers23 GVE tuples,4 dwarf names,7 protein tuples,9 rate tuples and both caps, not every datum.
coverage_quality.input_scope: Exact25 proposal identities checked as a multiset:24 additions and1 existing category-enum change;96 new and1 changed leaves. The primary ledger records97 read leaves,5 separate-helper leaves,48 main report/warning leaves without own monetary gates,203 contextual read sites and2 dynamic templates resolving8 keys. No claim that each leaf was independently reassessed for every semantic dimension.
coverage_quality.finding_limit: Overlapping groups include implementation defects, positive improvements, source-version questions, partial baseline representation, authority facts and result-contract boundaries; they are not a count of independent model mistakes.

code_location_control.count_unit: Repeated annotated code range/line and quoted-line occurrences, not unique production lines.
code_location_control.limit: A valid symbol/range anchor does not identify every clause branch; selected actual consumers were independently read in full module context.

additional_reading_page_bounds.scope: Explicit page/read arrays, source page numbers, paired extent endpoints and actual page-count declarations; repeated occurrences counted. This is bounds validation, not proof of source reading or interpretation.

quote_location_control.summary_resolution: Every otherwise unlocated input-finding summary repeats exactly its own bound child evidence quote, found on the declared original page.
quote_location_control.pre_freeze_corrections: Measure MB quotes restored original m³ instead of ASCII m3. Table modulation probes now quote their actually required bands; General countercases bind the actual arable-forage and park-exception clauses, not headings alone. These are explicit quotation corrections before final collection/replay; input and oracle changes are not silently implied.
quote_location_control.limit: A found quote, correct page range and matching artifact count do not independently prove source hierarchy, legal interpretation or full-source reading.

matcher_quality.method: Every evaluated contains_rule/excludes_rule matcher targets an actual list of objects with string rule_id. Empty collections are classified additionally from their native consumers. String IDs, category/index lists, maps and explicit Boolean/count projections retain their shapes.
matcher_quality.representation_limit: Missing keys, null, false, numeric zero, undefined output and runtime errors remain distinct; no law prescribes one OPA representation.

companion_consistency.integration_scope: Primary input review separately ran actual SQL-blocked App projection. This QC does not claim a second projection or add it to source-probe counts.

source_semantic_controls: Four known lawful source components:60m³ hose*1.1+40m³ shoe*1.5+20m³ injection*1.7=160EUR;30m³ actual own cattle separation*1.5=45EUR below3RDB-GVE*20cap;3ha pig area*54=162EUR; combined367EUR with modulation1. Actual category, N need, legal field conditions, records, timing, protein documentation and authority-free facts are positively stipulated. Unselected categories stay absent.
The45EUR separation component retains its amount and below-minimum flag. The50EUR provision is discretionary; no automatic legal zero-payment oracle is invented.

General negative admission/control-refusal results coexist with separately computed premium components. The client must honor admission and authority outcomes. This is an output-contract boundary, not proof every component estimate is an unlawful payment or every management breach mandates100% reduction.

Known40m³ eligible hose plus60m³ wholly ineligible injection biogas on2ha has no50m³/ha cap excess. Eligible volume40 is correct, but proportional allocation across techniques produces58.40EUR instead of known hose44EUR. This attribution error is separate from openly ambiguous A03 allocation when a cap is genuinely exceeded.

Known pure fallow remains N-zero with is_legume_pure_stand=false. The false-legume override wrongly admits fallow because it applies to both negative categories. The control uses a separation-only scenario; it demonstrates an area classifier error without inventing application on fallow or an illegal final award.

NAPV plant-specific conditional60/50kg allowances and measure9 explicit exclusion of legume pure stands serve different purposes. No automatic source conflict or subsidized-legume inclusion follows. Full NAPV need calculation needs yield, previous crop, soil Nmin, irrigation and geographic annex context not represented by the short negative classifier.

NAPV period and soil diagnostics remain warnings. Current native period uses16October instead of actual last-main-crop harvest and flags for complete exceptions. Slopes/incorporation, waters, storage,170kg, detailed crop/vegetable N schedules and extensive records are not a complete native baseline. Positive flags require the full external factual classification; warnings do not determine authority penalties.

A known own orchard application on15October receives the correct MB013 noneligible-use diagnosis but lacks the independently required NAPV§2(3) warning. It is a baseline warning gap, not conversion of orchard into supported arable land or a fixed sanction oracle.

Full lawful grazing of genuine arable forage satisfies its own ATB5/6 and SRL11 alternative; a cereal85percent harvested-area test wrongly excludes it. The qualified park control establishes actual absence of relevant park restrictions in HoheTauern, explicitly outside Neusiedlersee/DonauAuen. A paired known DonauAuen case remains rightly excluded. Neither is invented from an unknown geographic flag.

All23 AnnexA factors and four dwarf breeds match. Missing wild-ungulate/LN footnote concerns four foreign other-RGVE rows; own measure9 cattle and pigs do not consume them. Pig density uses whole arable area and actual annual mean; fallback integer head count is not automatically evidence of annual averaging.

All protein maxima and157g average group consumer are source-supported. Original MB merged cell spans3 phases. Genuine newerMB32kg versus olderSRL50kg unmated-gilt boundary remains open; no single silently chosen authority reading is scored as resolved.

Biogas allowed list has22 groups with source qualifications. The native consumer reads group keys and an aggregate non-defined-components flag. Hygienic status, no animal meal, no dressing/extractants/oil and reasonable permitted water must already be classified upstream. Missing evidence is not a known prohibited ingredient.

GSP-AV is actually supplied in this run. Changed §5 text enters with2026 amendment under §242(7), without its own retroactivity.2026+ ordinary weekend/holiday and future2028 Easter-Monday cases are separated from static MB17April facet and from historical2024/2025 normative claims.

The last new base entry2027 and conditional pig-option entry2028 do not by themselves establish a universal end of all existing annual contracts in2028. The discarded2029false draft is not a hard counterexample; unbounded native years retain an open source/version question.

GSP §48(2)Z6 uses Förderperiode and area-limited recovery after two100% cuts; ATB says Vertragszeitraum. Native stage export is not actual assignment, period history or recovery implementation. §51 concerns young farmers, not invented measure9 sanctions.

Timely notification of force majeure is a deadline component, not actual AMA recognition. Exit request after announced control, actual contract lapse, revision ending and reentry need correctly scoped state; their helper/diagnostic output is not automatically a whole authority contract engine.

Foreign animals and foreign N-eligible fields cannot contribute to own supported factors. A diagnostic alone does not filter the corresponding native aggregate. This does not mandate arbitrary all-farm zero or alter known Austrian positive controls.

Desired positive-evidence probes with missing personal, mechanical or quantity-application proof require withheld authorization or an explicit evidence result. They do not establish that the actual farmer missed a deadline, used a wrong technique or committed a breach.

Three valid nullable main errors are distinct: two new fields takeover.date and pig.start_year, one existing Canonical crop_name. The fourth structurally allowed duplicate-ration array has a functional identity conflict; it is not a null case. Two further main errors are outside schema. No missing-to-null-default crash and no helper-only crash are counted in this input subset.

Missing/null annual-average and GVE aggregates have safe explicit fallbacks; numeric0 is retained rather than overwritten. Contractor/shared equipment, biogas, recipe and applicable phase evidence have actual new positive gates. These improvements are preserved.

Actual SQL-blocked App projection retains0/24 additions,0/1 existing category extension and0/97 effective proposal leaves;9/13 extra Canonical paths remain, parcel crop and region do not. The projected defined eligiblefalse/lapsedtrue/zeroEUR result is an integration observation, not evidence of actual bad farming or a universal legal zero award.

independent_original_table_subcheck.scope: Independent bounded original-to-native table check; exact known tuples manually transcribed from original pages, not inferred from model-self-tests. This does not claim a second full semantic review of all ten data files or all NAPV schedules.

gve.result: all23 typed factor/null tuples and all4 dwarf names match; source age/size qualifiers directly compared in labels. Missing wild-ungulate/LN footnote correctly remains a low foreign-scope finding, without effect asserted on own cattle/pig totals.

pig_protein.result: all7 limits, 3phase membership and group-average bound match. Original page5 rendered image directly inspected:157g average cell spans all3 fattening phases. Raw assumption2 placement description is wrong, not the group consumer. Unmated-gilt32/50kg source-version difference remains open.

premium_rates.result: all9 year/rate/unit tuples and both caps match. 2023rates specifically sourced to MB; SRL2024rates not retroactively used.

bounded_explicit_enum_control.scope: Bounded check of every present explicit enum value in authored source-probe inputs against immutable Canonical plus actual run-proposed additions/changes. Absent fields, non-enum types, completeness, fact consistency and source truth are not certified. Deliberate stress mismatches are reported rather than silently exempted.

Historical policies, Canonical, sources, queries, source expectations and intended agricultural facts are unchanged. Input hashes are explicitly new; old input fixtures are not claimed unchanged.

Actual grassland land_use, crop truth, queries and expectations retained; new input and fixture hashes are explicit. Final full replay and enum scan bind the corrected version. No old input fixture is called unchanged.
